name: VR Native
summary: Output directly to a VR headset via OpenXR or SteamVR runtime. The headset receives separate left/right eye renders at native headset resolution with full lens distortion correction and timewarp. Highest quality VR output — no intermediate conversion.

variants.name: OpenXR
variants.description: Modern open standard. Supported by all major headsets (Quest, Pico, Index, WMR, Varjo, Pimax). Preferred for new implementations.

variants.name: SteamVR
variants.description: Valve's VR runtime. Broadest game compatibility. Acts as an OpenXR runtime on most headsets. Some older games only support SteamVR and not native OpenXR.

variants.name: Meta / Oculus SDK
variants.description: Meta's proprietary runtime for Quest headsets. Some games target this directly rather than OpenXR. PC Link and Air Link required for PCVR.

hardware_requirements: VR-ready GPU (RTX 3070 / RX 6700 XT or better recommended)
